escena: SCENE (staged, cinematic high-impact editorial photograph, a dark digital creative studio at night): a Chilean creative director in her late twenties, curly dark hair loose, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE HOODIE, stands on the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the waist up, one arm raised like an orchestra conductor, fingers spread, looking straight into the lens with a confident grin. Around her floats a tilted elliptical ORBIT of glowing digital content, as if she were conducting it: a dozen thin frameless screens of different real social and digital formats — tall vertical 9:16 story and reel screens, square 1:1 and 4:5 feed posts, wide 16:9 video frames, a slim phone, a web banner — hovering in the air at different depths, some sharp, some softly out of focus, the nearest one partly motion-blurred as it swings past the lens. Each screen shows bold, vivid, art-directed campaign imagery: saturated color-block graphics, a product close-up splashed with paint, a dancer mid-jump, a bold abstract gradient, a looping motion-graphic frozen mid-frame; the screens are the brightest objects and throw colored light onto her face, hoodie and the haze in vivid orange, hot magenta, deep azure-blue (#0375DB), violet and teal. Any tiny text on the screens is too small and too blurred to read. A thin luminous line of light traces the orbit path between the screens. Hard rim light from behind; haze catches the colored beams. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space, only a few far out-of-focus colored bokeh dots, no screens and no objects there. 50mm f/1.8, rich contrast, punchy color, no logos of any other brand.

lecho.objeto: the dark blurred edge of a worktable close to the lens

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark studio space on the left 45% of the frame
